title: Kie Senpai feat. Toast X T-Square Releases Hot New Sound Titled “Bentley”
htmlContent:
American artist Kie Senpai comes together with Toast and T-square to bring a record that is impossible to ignore with the new must-hear record “Bentley.” This track is a perfect record to show the magic of camaraderie in music, as well as the soul that will make people keep coming back for more.

Everything you hope to get when you hear something new is what shines through on “Bentley.” It is a daring display of music that runs wild in its own creative prowess to deliver something that his audiences must hear.
